coverage.note: 1988-01-06 to 1988-12-14. SOURCE: the assigned identifier minutesofmeeting1988sanf is NOT the Board of Permit Appeals; archive.org metadata shows it is Telecommunications Policy Committee minutes, so nothing was extracted from it. The 1988 BPA minutes are in the combined 1987-1988 volume minutesofmeeting19871988s, and only the 1988 meetings were extracted; the 1987 meetings were extracted separately. Read whole, first meeting to last: 33 regular meetings (Jan 6, 13, 20, 27; Feb 10, 17; Mar 9, 16, 23; Apr 13, 20; May 4, 11, 25; Jun 15, 22 (informational only, no findings), 29; Jul 13, 20; Aug 3, 10, 24, 31; Sep 14, 28; Oct 5, 19, 26; Nov 9, 16, 30; Dec 7, 14) plus 7 special blocks counted as meetings: the Jul 19 site inspection (88-155, 88-163), the Aug 23 site inspection by one commissioner (88-154), the Sep 19 site inspection (88-217), the Oct 17 site inspection (88-237/238/240, printed as SPECIAL MEETING OF THE BOARD), the Oct 31 site visit (V88-239), the Nov 29 site visit (88-230/231), and the Nov 16 closed session (4:30 p.m., Room 206, on the 88-170 litigation). No minutes in the scan for Feb 24, Mar 2 or Jun 8, 1988, though each is referenced in minutes that are in the scan; decisions from those meetings are recorded secondhand where a later meeting states them (Feb 24: 88-011, 87-341, 88-027, 87-366, 88-005; Mar 2: 88-029; Jun 8: 88-107, 88-108, 88-126), and the Jun 29 rehearing items for 88-125 and 88-129 are not recorded because the first is never identified by address anywhere and the second is a pushcart peddler appeal. No minutes in the scan for Feb 3, Mar 30, Apr 6, Apr 27, May 18, Jun 1, Jul 6, Jul 27, Aug 17, Sep 7, Sep 21, Oct 12, Nov 2, Nov 23, Dec 21 or Dec 28, 1988, and it is not known whether the Board met on those dates. The Apr 13, Jun 29 and Oct 5 minutes are each printed twice in the scan and counted once. A Dec 16, 1987 fragment is bound after the Jan 6, 1988 meeting and was not extracted. A new Board took office at the Jun 15 meeting, replacing the old Board. Votes recovered from later minutes: 88-123/88-124 (Jun 15 vote 4-1, stated Jun 29), 88-140 (Jun 29 vote 5-0, stated Jul 13), 88-176 (Aug 10 vote 4-0, stated Aug 31), 88-174 (Sep 14 vote 5-0, stated Oct 5), 88-223 (Sep 28 vote 5-0, stated Oct 19), 88-139 (Sep 28 rehearing vote 4-1, stated Oct 5), 88-263 (Nov 9 vote 4-0, stated Dec 7).
